ProgressDeadlineKind.description: Closed classes of long native work whose deadline is an idle window renewed by observable progress; each class declares its idle window and the generous maximum derived from the declared cost of the action.

ProgressDeadlinePolicy.description: A deadline of a long native action is NOT a fixed wall clock that a loaded host cannot meet: it expires after `idleMilliseconds` without observable progress, and never later than `maximumMilliseconds`, which is the nonrenewable ceiling `baseMilliseconds + perUnitMilliseconds * declared units` capped by `ceilingMilliseconds`. Renewal signals: child CPU time (sampled every `sampleMilliseconds`), child output, declared lease/queue/capacity waits and finished observation steps. A heartbeat the waiting process writes itself is not progress. Only the idle window is overridable by the named environment variable (natural milliseconds >= minimumIdleMilliseconds, four times the CPU sampling cadence so that a busy child is always sampled inside its window); the maximum is never renewable or overridable upwards.

ProgressDeadlineNotice.description: Both expiry notices and the refusals of invalid budgets and deadline inputs are written in every selected language (both while none is chosen); the idle notice names what renews the window. The two trace lines are written only when the trace environment variable is `1`: they show when a renewable deadline is created and every time the sampler saw child CPU work renew it.

idle.en: {label} stopped: no progress for {minutes} min (idle window {window} min). Child CPU time, child output, declared waits and finished observation steps renew the window.
idle.de: {label} gestoppt: seit {minutes} Min. kein Fortschritt (Leerlauffenster {window} Min.). Kind-CPU-Zeit, Kind-Ausgabe, deklarierte Wartezeiten und abgeschlossene Beobachtungsschritte erneuern das Fenster.

maximum.en: {label} stopped: the maximum duration of {minutes} min derived from its declared cost ({units} unit(s)) is reached.
maximum.de: {label} gestoppt: die aus den deklarierten Kosten ({units} Einheit(en)) abgeleitete Höchstdauer von {minutes} Min. ist erreicht.

traceCreated.de: [progress-deadline] {label}: Leerlauffenster {window} Min., Höchstdauer {minutes} Min. für {units} deklarierte Einheit(en)

traceWork.en: [progress-deadline] child CPU time moved ({children} process(es), {cpu} ms): idle windows renewed
traceWork.de: [progress-deadline] Kind-CPU-Zeit hat sich bewegt ({children} Prozess(e), {cpu} ms): Leerlauffenster erneuert

deadlineUnitsInvalid.en: The declared progress deadline units must be a nonnegative safe integer

deadlineIdleWindowInvalid.en: Invalid progress deadline idle window ({minimum}..{ceiling} ms, {environment})
